topology.transport: virtio-net over QEMU point-to-point TCP socket
topology.files: tmpfs, no fsync, RAM uncompressed without sparse/zero omission

measurement.working_set: MemAvailable minus 16MiB, nonzero64B per4KiB page; read/verify every page after restore then repeat warm scan
measurement.ram_backing: initial anonymous RAM; subsequent MAP_PRIVATE mappings of each node local received snapshot file; no cross-node RAM sharing
measurement.statistics: 20 samples per size, first3 warmups excluded;10 per direction. Means add for the5source-clock components; medians do not generally add.

limits: Nested KVM on one physical host; latency is not physical two-host migration latency.
Virtio-net/QEMU socket has strong direction asymmetry; do not interpret as physical NIC bandwidth.
First scan includes EPT population, backing-file faults, nested exit/entry, cold caches and scheduling. First-minus-warm is not isolated EPT time.
Diagnostic L1 fault helper durations include tracing and nested callees; exclude helper-outside exit/entry. They are not baseline pure EPT costs and must not be added to parent wall time.
One diskless vCPU; block/network/vsock state and disk migration not covered.
Workload reads after restore; later write-COW costs are excluded.
Semantic state bytes vary slightly with serialized variable-length fields.
